Notes

Dear Giles Hugo,

Here’s the notes from your call with +441494427500 01494 427500 on 21 September 2026 at 15:39:

This call involved Giles Hugo requesting to cancel a misordered item and arrange a refund, which the representative confirmed would be processed after shipment. They also discussed placing a new order for the correct item and inquired about panel components and quoting options. The call concluded with Giles Hugo thanking the representative, ABS, for their assistance.

Recap

  • Giles Hugo requested to cancel order 282105502 before shipment due to a misread of the product color, and inquired about white lenses; the representative explained the order was already in the warehouse and being prepared for dispatch, so cancellation was not possible, but the order would be shipped today with a full refund issued the next morning, including shipping costs of approximately 93.24 GBP, and the goods should arrive within 2-3 working days.
  • Giles Hugo agreed to dispose of the shipped items responsibly and asked about placing a new order for the correct product, which the representative advised could be done online after reviewing the datasheet and stock availability; the refund would be processed automatically once the return is received.
  • Giles Hugo inquired about panel components and requested a quote for a bill of materials, seeking assistance in obtaining the best price for a single unit and 10 sets; the representative explained that quotes could be requested via the UK website, with prices reflecting market rates, and offered to process the quote manually if needed.
  • The call ended with Giles Hugo thanking ABS for their help and confirming their name, and both parties exchanging good wishes.

Tasks

  • ABS will process the refund for order 282105502 tomorrow morning and ensure the amount, including shipping, is credited to the original payment method.
  • Giles Hugo will review the datasheet and stock availability online before placing a new order for the correct item.
  • Giles Hugo will send the bill of materials to UK maza.com for a quote on the panel components, requesting assistance in obtaining the best price for one unit and ten sets.
